scope: Read-only source and existing ordinary-observation diagnostic review; no new imports, exclusion, pooling or causal timing attribution.
sourceFinding: The new BoundedZipTextWriter does not extend TextWriter or Uint8ArrayWriter.
_getFilesFromArchive/getDenseEntryData recognizes only those two existing writer classes for its bounded native small-entry path.
A small bounded tag writer therefore falls through to zipReader.getEntries() and an all-entry Map on a dense catalog. The normal late TextWriter uses the native fast path.

Dense directory admission requires archive at least128MiB and at least8192entries. The pinned JMdict/Jitendex archives are below128MiB, so correcting this route cannot change their primary code path or rescue the failed JMdict evidence.
interpretation: Whole-catalog hydration before terms is a concrete experiment integration defect and a plausible cause of the VNDB memory/time regression. A focused reproducer is required; no attributable millisecond or byte saving is claimed from these overlapping counters. No new full-import campaign is warranted solely for a fix unreachable by JMdict.
